claims.claim: Declares scripted workflow execution with asynchronous operation as the default.
Validates runs.run and runs.all calls, then launches runs.all children as one observed parallel batch.
Applies discovered agent launch defaults and resolves child context from request, package, and agent preferences.
Resolves child model and thinking from launch overrides plus agent configuration.
Resolves tool budget and timeout from launch, agent, package, and environment settings.
Builds the child tool plan from agent tool configuration and inherited capability limits.
Routes slash, prompt-template, and RPC delegation bridges through public or delegated executors.
Registers the subagent tool with the public execution bridge.
Registers wait and slash-command surfaces for lifecycle and operator control.
Persists background run state to a status file in the run directory.
Writes the current background status payload through a resilient persistence layer.
Persists a recovery descriptor before starting an internal background child.
Resolves resume targets from persisted run status and recovery data, rejecting stopped runs.
Restores active background jobs from persisted run summaries and resumes watching them.
